name: tag_write

inputBounds.hardItemsPolicyRule: a deployment may raise the 20-item default through the Runtime Target Policy and never above the 100-item hard ceiling

nativeOutcome: system.tag.writeBlocking QualityCode per item; observed state does not decide success

runtimeTargetPolicy.allowlistMatch: provider-qualified prefix at segment boundaries; explicit * allows every provider
runtimeTargetPolicy.reservedProviderRefusal: permission_denied before Preflight, whatever the allowlist says, including an explicit *

preflight: input, reserved provider and Target allowlist for every item before any item executes, with no rollback
deniedMutationAudit: after a usable Policy is read, a refused target produces one `decision` row and no dispatch; `off` records nothing, and `required` refuses the call when the denial row cannot be written
outcomePreservation: a dispatched batch reports its per-item Native outcomes whatever the Observed-state budget or the serializer does; an Observed value that cannot be returned is an explicit `limit_exceeded` observed error, and the result is re-rendered without the Observed state rather than replacing the outcomes
itemOutcomeUnknownScope: only items whose native outcome is itself indeterminate
